messages.text: I sign both Council assignments and request Guard with no Warrant. The distribution benefit makes the repair month less bitter, but it supplies no enemy for Spear. I will not send the cohort searching for a target merely to demonstrate anger. Guard uses the same offered Vigil as our proposed Warrant and earns the civilian benefit without confusion. At the Ceremony, remind them that we could have withheld these assets after their refusal and instead chose service. I still expect an independent army, not praise followed by another command to obey.

reason: The disclosure strengthens the civilian case for Repair and Trade but does not resolve Raid viability. The order change coordinates protection; my exact assignments remain unchanged and unconditionally approved.
